properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ZUUKUKA mwoyo gwange,
Katonda-akusembeza,
Taakugobere bweru,
Akwagalira ddala.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Gw'osaba ye Kabaka
Omuyinza wa byonna,
-Okumukooyesa teri
Olw'ekisa kye-ekingi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu,sooka-ontikkule
Omugugu ogw'ebibi,
Ogunzitoowerera,
Gwe sijja kusobola.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mu musaayi-ogwayiika
Edda ku musaalaba;
Ku lw'abalina-ebibi,
Yesu,-onnaalize ddala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Nkooye nnyo,ompummuze
Weemale-omwoyo gwange,
Njagala-Omulokozi
Anammalamu-ebibi.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Bwe ntyo bwe nkuyimbira
Bulijjo ettendo lyo;
Abakwesiga wekka,
Baliraba-ekisa kyo
